tokens.name: brand-maroon
tokens.usage: Logo ink, sampled from the Varnika logo. Reserve for the logo and a single lotus brand moment per page; never for buttons, links or body text.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Logo gold, sampled from the lotus. Logo only, or one hairline ornament per page (Brand Story divider). Never text: 2:1 on ivory.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Warm Ivory. Default page background (`bg-page`). Most of every screen is this colour.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Soft Cream. Alternate homepage sections, footer, image placeholders (`bg-alt`).

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Light Blush. Highlighted sections such as Brand Story; at most one blush section per page (`bg-highlight`).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure White. Product cards' info area, form fields, modals, drawers, admin panels (`surface`).

tokens.name: champagne
tokens.usage: Champagne Beige. Decorative dividers and card separators only (`border-subtle`); never the edge of an input (1.5:1).

tokens.name: dusty-rose
tokens.usage: Dusty Rose. Soft accents: Featured badge fill, selected-filter tint, hover wash. `brown` text on it is 5.1:1.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Soft Sage. Occasional variation: New arrival badge fill. `brown` text on it is 4.6:1. Never more than one sage element per view.

tokens.name: taupe
tokens.usage: Warm Taupe as specified. Decorative only (icons in disabled state, skeleton blocks). Fails as text (2.6:1 on ivory): use `taupe-deep` for secondary text.

tokens.name: rosewood
tokens.usage: Muted Rosewood as specified. Accent for large serif text (24px+, 3.7:1), active nav underline, selected swatch ring. Not a button fill: white on it is 4.1:1.

tokens.name: rosewood-deep
tokens.usage: Rosewood, deepened toward the logo maroon so white labels pass (6.2:1). Primary button fill and text links on ivory, cream, blush and white (5.0:1 or better).

tokens.name: rosewood-dark
tokens.usage: Primary button hover/pressed and link hover; also the focus ring (7.5:1 on ivory, 6.6:1 on blush).

tokens.name: taupe-deep
tokens.usage: Secondary text: product fabric line, helper text, captions, meta. 5.3:1 on ivory, 5.0:1 on cream, 4.7:1 on blush, 5.8:1 on white.

tokens.name: brown
tokens.usage: Deep Brown. Headings and body text on every light surface (8.5:1 on ivory, 7.5:1 on blush, 9.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Control border: inputs, checkboxes, quantity stepper, secondary-button outline. 3.7:1 on ivory, 3.3:1 on blush, 4.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (In stock, Saved). 5.4:1 on `success-bg`, 5.9:1 on ivory. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Success alert and status-badge fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (Only 2 left, Pending). 5.6:1 on `warning-bg`. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning alert and status-badge fill.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text, invalid input border and icon. 5.6:1 on `error-bg`, 6.3:1 on ivory. Always paired with an icon and a message.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Error alert fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind Modal, Drawer and BottomSheet.

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page background, storefront and admin.

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section background; footer.

tokens.name: bg-highlight
tokens.usage: Highlighted section (Brand Story).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, modals, drawers, tables.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body on `bg-page`, `bg-alt`, `bg-highlight`, `surface`.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text on the same four grounds.

tokens.name: text-on-action
tokens.usage: Label on `action-primary` (6.2:1) and `action-primary-hover` (8.2:1).

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Inline links and TextButton on every light ground.

tokens.name: text-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link and TextButton hover.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: PrimaryButton fill.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: PrimaryButton hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: action-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: SecondaryButton and IconButton hover wash.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers: header bottom, section rules, attribute rows.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of interactive controls (meets 3:1).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Selected swatch/option outline; SecondaryButton hover edge.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element.

families.sans: "DM Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero heading only, once per page. 40px below 768px.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles (collection, product name on PDP). 34px below 768px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Collection card titles, modal titles, empty-state titles. 22px below 768px.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Handpicked sarees from weavers we know by name.
styles.usage: Hero and Brand Story paragraphs. 17px below 768px.

styles.name: body

styles.usage: Default text: descriptions, form text, admin tables. Never smaller for paragraphs.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Kanjivaram silk · 6.3 m with blouse piece

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The smallest size in the system: legal lines, image credits. Never for actions.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase label above a section heading. The only uppercase style; one per section.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, filter group names, attribute names.

styles.name: product-name
styles.usage: Product name on cards; two lines max.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Selling price on cards and cart lines.

styles.name: price-lg
styles.usage: Selling price on the product detail page.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges; price to original price.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; label to input.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between card text lines; chip gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; grid gap on mobile; field to field.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Tablet gutter; desktop grid gap; card-to-heading gap; form group spacing.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; nav link gap; modal padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Mobile section padding (top and bottom).

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Tablet section padding; heading block to grid on desktop.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Desktop section padding (top and bottom).

radius.note: Nearly square. Rounded corners are not a decoration here.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Hero and editorial photographs, section blocks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Product and collection images, badges, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, select, chips, alerts, toasts, tables.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modal and the top corners of BottomSheet only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only for count bubbles (cart count) and status dots; never buttons.

shadow.note: Shadows only for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Sticky header once scrolled; dropdown menus.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Toast, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modal, Drawer, BottomSheet.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and divider.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Focus ring, selected swatch or option, invalid input.

tokens.name: container-text
tokens.usage: Long-form text, forms, Brand Story copy column.

tokens.name: container-md
tokens.usage: Checkout, account pages, ContactCTA.

tokens.name: container-lg

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Hero and full-bleed editorial imagery cap.

tokens.name: bp-sm

tokens.name: bp-lg

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide desktop: container caps at `container-lg`.
